prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1266; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the above-named individual in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection involving your insured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative has spoken with our client about the incident, please let us know so that we may address it.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured for this loss, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera and telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, and any repair or salvage records for the vehicles involved. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or destroyed while this matter is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
